blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines—Juan Gomez de Liaño proved to be Converge’s biggest weapon once again in its 130-125 win over Rain or Shine in Game 2 of the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals at Ninoy Aquino Stadium on Friday night. Gomez de Liaño called the FiberXers’ sorry series-opening loss a “wake-up call” that helped the team respond with a sharper performance. “[The] first game was a wake up call for us so I’m glad we all woke up locked in,” he said. “I’m just grateful for the win but the job’s not finished yet.
